targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_capacity_snapshots WHERE pressure_state = 'critical' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replay_economics_runs WHERE is_bounded = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM query_performance_snapshots WHERE latency_state IN ('degraded','critical') AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM storage_capacity_snapshots WHERE capacity_state = 'critical'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replay_amplification_reports WHERE exceeds_safe_threshold = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partition_pressure_snapshots WHERE health_state != 'healthy'
SELECT pressure_state, COUNT(*) as count FROM telemetry_capacity_snapshots WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY pressure_state
SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, ROUND(p95_latency_ms::numeric, 1) as p95_ms FROM query_performance_snapshots ORDER BY backend, id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, ROUND(current_size_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) as size_mb FROM storage_capacity_snapshots ORDER BY backend, id DESC
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) as time, AVG(events_per_sec) as eps FROM telemetry_capacity_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, AVG(amplification_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM replay_amplification_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT scope, ROUND(projected_30d_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) as proj_30d_mb, ROUND(projected_90d_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) as proj_90d_mb, storage_exhaustion_forecast, queue_pressure_forecast, confidence_level FROM capacity_projection_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT scope, backend, ROUND(daily_cost_estimate::numeric, 4) as daily, ROUND(monthly_cost_estimate::numeric, 2) as monthly, ROUND(projected_90d_cost::numeric, 2) as proj_90d, estimation_method FROM infrastructure_cost_estimates ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT field_name, pressure_type, cardinality_count, ROUND(growth_rate_pct::numeric, 1) as growth_pct, severity, bounded FROM cardinality_pressure_reports ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT 'cost_estimates_advisory' as check_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_advisory = false) as violations FROM infrastructure_cost_estimates UNION ALL SELECT 'replay_bounded', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_bounded = false) FROM replay_economics_runs UNION ALL SELECT 'cardinality_unbounded', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bounded = false) FROM cardinality_pressure_reports
